subject: Evervale access controls onboarding — SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service-account plan
messages:
From: Brad Hart <brad.hart@evervale.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Allen <jane.allen@evervale.com>, procurement@evervale.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evervale — access controls kickoff for Redwood onboarding

Hi Naomi / Connor,

Thanks for agreeing to get Redwood live for Evervale. We're ready to start the access-controls piece of the onboarding. High-level asks from our side: SSO via SAML, SCIM provisioning for users/groups, a static IP allowlist for outbound connections, and a small set of service accounts for integrations (CI/CD, analytics).

We've attached a short network diagram and the current list of IP ranges we plan to reserve. Questions to start:
- Who on Redwood side owns the SAML metadata exchange?
- Do you support SCIM push provisioning with standard group mappings (email, title, department)?
- How do you recommend we handle service-account scopes (least privilege vs. broad admin)?

Attaching: evervale-network.pdf (network diagram)

Thanks,
Brad Hart
IT Lead, Evervale Systems
[Attachment: evervale-network.pdf]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Brad Hart <brad.hart@evervale.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evervale — access controls kickoff for Redwood onboarding

Thanks Brad — great to meet you in this thread.

Connor will lead the technical implementation, Marissa (CS manager) will own the project coordination and scheduling. Quick answers up front:
- SAML metadata: we can exchange XML metadata files; Connor will send the Redwood metadata and an SSO test account.
- SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 with the common attributes (userName, name, emails, groups). We'll share our schema and a sample mapping.
- Service accounts: recommend scoped service accounts per integration; we provide token rotation guidance and least-privilege examples.

Propose a 60-minute kickoff tomorrow at 10:00 PT to walk the network constraints and finalize the mutual action plan. If that works, Marissa will send calendar invites and a short agenda.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[signature]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Brad Hart <brad.hart@evervale.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evervale — access controls kickoff for Redwood onboarding

Brad / Naomi — quick technical checklist so we can be prepared for the kickoff:
1) SAML
   - Please send Evervale IdP metadata (xml) and a test SAML user.
   - Confirm NameID format (email) and whether you enforce encrypted assertions.
2) SCIM
   - Token type (Bearer) and scope for provisioning.
   - Group sync cadence (we typically support delta + full sync).
   - We'll attach our SCIM schema and example mapping.
3) IP allowlist
   - If you're planning outbound allowlisting, please provide final egress ranges (CSV welcome).
4) Service accounts
   - List of integration targets (CI/CD, monitoring). Provide desired names and minimal privilege lists.
5) Test plan
   - One staging user per role, and a rollback plan for immediate disable if needed.

Attached: redwood-scim-schema-v2.json (sample)

I'll bring the SAML metadata and a staging tenant to the call.

—Connor
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-scim-schema-v2.json]

From: Jane Allen <jane.allen@evervale.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Brad Hart <brad.hart@evervale.com>, procurement@evervale.com
Date: 2027-05-31T08:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evervale — access controls kickoff for Redwood onboarding

Thanks team — attaching the IP ranges export and a short spreadsheet of our current service accounts. A couple points from security:
- We require assertion encryption for SAML for any production SSO.
- SCIM tokens must be rotated every 90 days and stored in our vault (we'll share access rules).
- Service accounts for CI should be scoped to read-only on logs and write-only for deployments; no admin privileges.

I'll add the spreadsheet and iplist to the DocuSign package for approval of outbound network changes so procurement can track it.

Attachments: evervale-iplist.csv (IP ranges), evervale-service-accounts.xlsx

Regards,
Jane Allen
Head of Security, Evervale Systems
[Attachment: evervale-iplist.csv]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-01T10:45:00-07:00

Forwarding a short security checklist that we require for Private deployments and high-compliance customers. Naomi — copying the expected asks below so they can be included in the mutual action plan:

> From: Compliance Bot <no-reply@redwood.com>
> To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
> Date: 2027-06-01T10:40:00-07:00
> Subject: Security onboarding checklist (excerpt)

>
We should ask Evervale which retention window they require and whether they'll use customer-managed keys. I'll bring the checklist to the kickoff call.

—Jonas

Great progress everyone — recap and next steps before the kickoff (scheduled 2027-06-03 10:00 PT):

- Redwood: share SAML metadata and a staging SSO test account (Connor) — done, see attached sample.
- Evervale: confirm service-account names and scopes (Jane) — please add to the mutual action plan for sign-off.
